title: Before & After Fire Damage Restoration - Brisbane Complete Fire Recovery Transformation
description: Dramatic before and after comparison of complete fire and smoke damage restoration in Brisbane property. Left side shows extensive fire damage with blackened ceiling, charred walls, smoke stains, and debris. Right side displays fully restored room with pristine white walls, restored decorative ceiling rose, polished timber floors, and like-new condition. Demonstrates IICRC-certified fire restoration expertise transforming severely damaged property to better-than-original condition. Project completed in 6-8 weeks with 100% insurance approval, representing typical $85,000 fire damage restoration by Brisbane's leading fire recovery specialists with 25+ years experience.
